contract.baseline: UNRUN candidate: original native pure-Triton shape/tuning selection, not B200-specific optimization
contract.input_generation: CPU fp32 generator seed20261020+shape_index, then CPU cast to true requested input dtype
contract.timed_scope: One direct original decorated forward Triton kernel after initial autotune. Outputs preallocated; no Torch native GPU compute, allocation, hidden casts, backward, copy or state helper in fn.
contract.source_transform: Strip tuning/heuristic wrappers by selecting their existing JITFunction; original kernel body unchanged
contract.fp8_policy: True float8 input and output. Dot operators use native float8 tl.dot with fp32 accumulator; no harness fp16 substitution. Convolution computes fp32 from float8 storage; cache only copies storage.
contract.precision_validation: FP32 IEEE tl.dot allow_tf32=False explicit at every selected dot; independent CPU fp64 reference. FP32 matrix tolerance rtol2e-5/atol1e-4 prespecified for K<=512, not changed in response to observations.
contract.formula: y[b,t,d]=bias[d]+sum_w x[b,t-(W-1-w),d]*weight[w,d], zero causal left padding
contract.entrypoint: Exact FLA causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel body, explicit launch metadata
contract.layout_adapter: A5 logical weight[W,D] transposed to FLA contiguous weight[D,W] before timing; no activation/residual/state
contract.launch: Original decorated kernel chooses native configuration; capture actual best_config/compiled metadata after first correctness call
contract.accumulator_dtype: fp32; FP8 storage does not imply FP8 TensorCore arithmetic
contract.native_feature_heuristics: Original HAS_WEIGHT/HAS_BIAS/HAS_RESIDUAL/USE_INITIAL_STATE/IS_VARLEN decorators retained; derived from actual pointers
contract.layout: Original [B,T,D] input and contiguous [D,W] packed weight retained, prepared outside fn
contract.rounding: Original FP32 accumulation and final rtne requested-dtype store unchanged; no fp16 substitution for FP8
contract.source_policy: Fixed official FLA9d478f. Kernel function AST, signature, body and complete original decorators unchanged. Original env.py/cache.py helpers loaded in isolation; no complete FLA import or installation.
contract.dispatcher_scope: Reproduce original CUDA pure-Triton default shape selection into preallocated outputs. Optional multi-backend registry/CUDA/mix/Gluon replacements are not reproduced and explicit requests are rejected.
contract.same_contract: All old100 shapes/index/CPU seed/actual storage tensors/independent CPUfp64 refs/all returned outputs/stats/tolerances/useful+additional bytes retained exactly, only fn and dispatch metadata change.
